policy.goal: Win back customers who have not ordered recently by sending one relevant, consented follow-up that leads to a repeat purchase.

approval.rule: Any discount at or below the autonomous limit may be granted by the worker; anything above it must be approved by the owner before the message is sent.

guardrails: One follow-up per customer per cooldown window.
The messaging and reorder tools refuse to run when approval is required and missing.

dataset.note: Eligible with no incentive justified — the autonomous success case.
Eligible — the subject of the customer-rejection scenario.
Repeat buyer inactive 75 days — the analysis justifies 15% off, which crosses the autonomous limit and needs the owner.
Hindi speaker with a stored preference — shows memory recall and language-aware drafting under an approval.
Declined an offer 10 days ago — the cooldown rule must refuse to re-contact.
Ordered 12 days ago — too recent to nudge.
Never consented to marketing — outreach is not permitted.
Inactive 240 days — beyond the window where one message is honest.
Opted out of outreach — blocked at policy level.
